a:r.a:t: Urban airspace is rapidly becoming contested as autonomous delivery systems proliferate.
3D obstacle avoidance in dense cityscapes demands computationally efficient, robust path planners.
Regulatory frameworks require explicit no-fly zone modeling — a constraint 2D planners cannot satisfy.
Algorithm selection must balance path optimality, runtime performance, and safety margins simultaneously.
